title: Bermuda bar: a stranger's birthday unlocks a woman's phone

tellings.quote: So I said, "Um, put in your birthday." And he puts in his birthday and the phone opens.

plain: A man named Chris Ramsay says that in a bar in Bermuda he told a stranger to type his own birthday into a woman's locked phone, and the phone opened. Ramsay tells Michels he was there: "I said, 'Um, put in your birthday.' And he puts in his birthday and the phone opens." He tells it as a strange coincidence, or more, that he can't explain.
